why_a_missing_anchor_is_a_survivor: a table entry whose text is no longer in the file has stopped testing anything. Skipping it would let a component drift out from under its own mutations while the score stayed green.
why_a_red_baseline_is_refused: against a failing suite every mutation looks killed, so the score would be a perfect 100% that measured nothing.
